skill.name: set-up-shopware-chatgpt-ads-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to connect Shopware 6 and verify lifetime revenue or profit signals for value-based bidding in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.summary: Set up and verify Shopware lifetime value events before you select a conversion in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most scanner hits are Markdown, documentation links, or routine setup checks, not shell substitution or reconnaissance. Confirmed risks include remote tool execution, broad order lookups, an unpinned installer, and unsafe handling of conversion keys. The workflow also lacks explicit approval for enabling data forwarding and gives conflicting guidance on the LTV conversion.

remediation.issue: The agent workflow permits direct handling of API keys.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to enter conversion keys and pairing tokens in the designated browser forms. Prohibit secrets in chat and command arguments.

remediation.issue: The setup can enable customer data forwarding without explicit merchant approval.
remediation.suggestion: Show the selected property, sales channel, pixel, and data categories before enabling forwarding. Require explicit approval and verify that the consent configuration matches the storefront.

remediation.issue: A test-order check can read unrelated customer orders.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for the exact test order ID and confirm the sales channel before the lookup. Return only the delivery status and requested value fields.

remediation.issue: The MCP workflow invokes remote operations without an operation allowlist.
remediation.suggestion: Use an approved MCP connection and an explicit list of allowed operations. Confirm the target and obtain consent before any write.

remediation.issue: The installation example does not pin the installer or skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and reviewed skill revision. Treat installation as a separate operation that requires user approval.

remediation.issue: The fallback workflow treats live documentation as equivalent to the reviewed instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle versioned references and use the reviewed copies for actions. Treat live documentation as informational and verify changes before allowing them to drive writes.

remediation.issue: The main skill substitutes an order-profit event for the profit LTV event.
remediation.suggestion: Use the profit LTV event for lifetime profit and the revenue LTV event for lifetime revenue. Verify the exact event in Ads Manager before changing a campaign.

semantic_findings.title: API Key Handling Can Expose Secrets
semantic_findings.description: The skill permits the agent to request an OpenAI Conversions API key and pass it to a command. A key provided this way could enter chat history, command arguments, or tool logs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception is explicit and conflicts with the reference's instruction not to paste the key into chat. No evidence of actual credential disclosure was found.

semantic_findings.title: Customer Data Forwarding Lacks a Merchant Approval Step
semantic_findings.description: The workflow can initiate tracking setup when it is missing and tells the merchant to leave forwarding enabled. The destination receives matching and device data, not only conversion values.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The references document shopper consent checks and an explicit save action. They do not require separate confirmation of the pixel and data categories before setup enables forwarding.

semantic_findings.title: Live Documentation Can Change Agent Actions
semantic_findings.description: If bundled references are absent, the skill directs the agent to fetch and follow live Markdown. The replacement instructions are not pinned to the audited revision.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback treats a mutable page as equivalent to the bundled instructions. No evidence of malicious content on those pages was found in the reviewed files.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Guidance Can Select the Wrong Bidding Signal
semantic_findings.description: The main skill names the order-profit event for profit bidding. The LTV reference identifies a different event for lifetime profit, so the merchant could optimize for the wrong value.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The references explicitly distinguish order profit from profit LTV. The main workflow leaves campaign selection to the merchant, but the mistaken event could still guide that selection.

content.user_title: Set Up Shopware LTV Bidding in ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: A first purchase does not show how much a customer spends over repeat orders. This skill guides you through sending and verifying lifetime value events from Shopware with Product Metrics.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP connection when configured.
Guide a Shopware administrator through pairing one sales channel and linking the correct property.
Guide the connection of a ChatGPT Ads pixel and explain how to check event delivery.
Explain the consent, customer identification, and cost requirements for revenue and profit LTV events.
Check whether a test order arrived in Product Metrics and guide the merchant through confirming the matching event in Ads Manager.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro and a supported Shopware 6.7 installation with PHP 8.2 or later.
One installation tracks one sales channel. Historical orders are not imported, and later refunds do not revise events already sent to ChatGPT Ads.
LTV events require a recognized customer and marketing and analytics consent. Profit LTV also requires complete order costs.
The merchant completes Shopware administration steps and selects the campaign conversion in Ads Manager.

use_cases.title: Check whether a store is ready
use_cases.description: Identify the account access, plugin setup, and consent settings needed before connecting a Shopware sales channel.

use_cases.title: Verify a revenue LTV event
use_cases.description: Check a paid test order and confirm the revenue LTV event before changing a campaign's conversion.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing profit events
use_cases.description: Check whether consent, customer identification, or incomplete order costs explain why a paid test order did not produce profit LTV.

prompt_templates.title: List setup prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need for Shopware revenue LTV bidding in ChatGPT Ads. Do not change settings or request any secrets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Learn what accounts and access are required.

prompt_templates.title: Review my setup status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the Product Metrics setup status for [property] and [sales channel]. Report completed steps and what I need to do next. Do not make changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Continue an existing setup without repeating completed steps.

prompt_templates.title: Check a single test order
prompt_templates.prompt: Check only test order [order ID] in [sales channel]. Report whether it arrived and whether its profit value is available. Omit customer details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Diagnose an expected LTV event using a known test order.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a one-campaign LTV test
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare revenue LTV and profit LTV for [campaign]. Check event choice, consent, and cost coverage. Explain how to verify the selected event without changing the campaign.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Plan a limited rollout and define checks before a campaign change.

output_examples.input: The Shopware channel is active, but the ChatGPT Ads destination is not connected. What is next?
output: Confirm which property, sales channel, and ad pixel you intend to connect.
Enter the Conversions API key in the Product Metrics connection form, not in chat.
After reviewing the data to be sent and enabling forwarding, place a paid test order and check delivery before selecting a campaign conversion.

output_examples.input: The test order produced revenue LTV but no profit LTV. What should I check?
output: Confirm the test order has a complete contribution margin, including product costs and any additional costs.
Once those costs are active, place another paid test order with the required consent.
Verify that the lifetime-profit event appears in Ads Manager. The order-profit event is not the same conversion.

best_practices: Enter conversion keys and pairing tokens only in the designated browser forms.
Confirm the sales channel, property, ad pixel, consent settings, and data to be shared before enabling forwarding.
Verify the exact LTV event with a paid test order and start with one campaign.
anti_patterns: Pasting a conversion key or pairing token into an assistant conversation.
Selecting the order-profit event when the campaign should optimize for lifetime profit.
Listing recent customer orders when you only need to verify one known test order.

faq.question: Does this work with Shopware 5?
faq.answer: No. The documented setup requires Shopware 6.7 and PHP 8.2 or later.

faq.question: Can I start with revenue LTV and add profit LTV later?
faq.answer: Yes. Revenue LTV does not require order costs. Profit LTV requires a complete contribution margin.

faq.question: Does each order send the customer's full lifetime value?
faq.answer: No. Each event carries only that order's contribution. The sum of observed contributions represents lifetime value.

faq.question: What shopper consent is needed for LTV events?
faq.answer: LTV events require marketing and analytics consent. Without ad personalization consent, the integration marks an otherwise eligible event as opted out.

faq.question: Will orders from before setup appear in ChatGPT Ads?
faq.answer: No. Historical orders are not imported. The guide also notes that ChatGPT Ads accepts events up to seven days old.

faq.question: Can the assistant change which conversion my campaign uses?
faq.answer: No. The merchant selects the conversion in Ads Manager. The assistant can explain the available events and help verify delivery.
